earnings.title: Kimco Realty ® Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: For the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, Net income available to the company’s common shareholders (“Net income”) per diluted share was $0.41 and $0.19, respectively.
Grew same property net operating income* ("NOI") 4.9% year-over-year.
Net income for the third quarter of 2026 was $272.5 million, or $0.41 per diluted share, compared to $130.2 million, or $0.19 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2025.
Achieved pro-rata cash rent spreads of 31.5% on comparable new leases.
Repurchased 6.3 million shares of common stock totaling $150 million and repurchased approximately $74 million of preferred stock.

quotes.text: Our third quarter results reflect strong execution, with record occupancy, significant pricing power on new leases and further acceleration in same property NOI growth.
